messages.author: 889de486273d901d
messages.subject: html + pdf using rmarkdown::render()
parts:
I apologize if this is the wrong forum for this question - I did not see a better one dedicated to just rmarkdown.

I am using the new rmarkdown package to render Rmd files to both html and pdf.
How can I generate tables that will work well with both html and pdf output when using rmarkdown::render()?

When generating html, I need to set options(xtable.type="html") in my first knitr chunk.
When generating pdf, I need to set options(xtable.type="latex")

In addition there are some other format-specific modifications I need to make to support side-by-side tables.

Is there some option set by render that will let me test which output format it is targeting?
I tried getting access to output_format$pandoc$to from inside my knitr blocks without success.

Thanks in advance for any help.
